author: Myeongjin Kang
target: Existence of one finite-dimensional symmetric F_2-algebra and one finite-dimensional nonprojective module with Ext^i(M,M)=0 for every i>=1.
support: Every nonzero finite-order q breaks exactness of the source's displayed starting complex, with explicit first homology and rank formulas.
Conditional on retaining the polynomial and fiber profiles, finite-order scalar twists and finite-field graded automorphism replacements leave nonzero comparison kernels.
The attempted H=0 twisted regular bimodule loses right projectivity and has no finite projective resolution; this does not exclude other noninvertible-action functors.
For every finite Ext window the generic source pair spreads out to a finite field and restricts to F_2. Prime-field dimensions may grow with the window.
A full finite-field witness would have syzygy dimensions tending to infinity. This is a necessary condition, not a contradiction.
unpaid: Construct a single full finite-field witness or rule out every such pair. No uniform prime-field dimension bound or replacement all-degree mechanism was obtained.
